purpose: Make the first mission's service, money and victory conditions executable. Adapt to the actual repository schema and prove both reference plans before claiming balance.

start.note: Agent availability is a customer fact. Licences and supported queues still require procurement. Staffing eligibility and permissions remain validated.

contract.activation: Purchased entitlements, required identity/carrier/queue/context/digital dependencies and funded implementation are effective. Activation alone does not prove delivery.
contract.settlement: Global 60-minute provider boundaries. First partial period is explicitly prorated under authored retail/supplier terms; metered usage follows actual work. Partial periods do not count towards victory.
contract.credit_cap: Actual charged retail amount for that period; never create a negative customer invoice.
contract.renewal: At least two qualifying full periods among the last three, retained required context/evidence and no unresolved critical obligation. A failed renewal can trigger an authored corrective proposal or exit; the player cannot force acceptance.
contract.exit: Three consecutive failed full periods terminate this starter contract. Complete or explicitly transfer retained work and information obligations. No repeated signing bonus or reset of history.

steady_period_demand.handoff_and_retry: Retain a single customer case and deadline. Do not count repeated attempts as extra resolved cases.
steady_period_demand.peak_variant: A supported seed clusters a declared subset of arrivals into a busy window while preserving the case count and explicit deadlines. Prove feasible responses before publishing the seed.
steady_period_demand.calibration_note: These are synthetic game units. They are not a model of real CC staffing performance.

plan_a.initial_position: Preserve capital and delivery speed; expose a declared dependency, term or operating-cost tradeoff.

plan_b.initial_position: Commit more capital and/or implementation time for a declared ongoing-cost or capability advantage. Retain a meaningful limitation that makes the other plan preferable for some supported opportunities.

balance_targets.do_not: Do not hardcode the target margin, double-charge these aggregate totals alongside their component charges, make required dependencies free, or assume the illustrative balance has been tested.

incident.scheduler: Engine-owned, seeded and attached to a dependency actually used by this customer. Trigger after initial observed service; retain the seed and command history.
incident.required_responses: At least two sensible responses with distinct money/time/service consequences. Prior redundancy must protect only its actual failure domain.
incident.scope: Carrier, identity or digital-connector incident variants must not all be solved by the same second-carrier purchase.
incident.repair: Funded validated work, duration and dependencies; no unconditional recovered=true action.

insolvency.unfunded_discretionary_commitment: Reject atomically unless an authored credit offer is explicitly accepted.
insolvency.unpaid_posted_obligation: Record arrears and expose a one-period grace window with no new discretionary commitment.
insolvency.default: If still overdue at the next boundary, enter the mission's explicit failure state. Financing or a rescue, if offered by difficulty, has a disclosed receipt and cannot create operating profit.

victory.provider_operating_result_each_period: greater than zero, after actual supplier costs, provider operating costs and service credits; financing and opening capital are excluded
victory.next_contract: An additional real customer opportunity is accepted with funded implementation, valid capacity/staff reservations and visible remaining obligations.

acceptance: Both costed reference plans complete the mission through visible UI controls under documented supported seeds.
At least one changed deadline, available offer, demand pattern or dependency exposure changes a useful plan or response; neither plan dominates every supported case.
An unstaffed/unconnected service fails for its real cause and can recover by legitimate work.
The bill reconciles observed workload and contractual terms. The last readiness snapshot cannot rewrite the period.
A second customer uses the same provider cash and staff. The creation event adds no capital.
Save/restore and worker/speed execution preserve the same future events and accounting.
